item.title: Slovakia buys out Czech stake in new nuclear project company
item.description: ČEZ has sold its 49% stake in JESS, the company formed to develop new nuclear capacity in Slovakia, for EUR189 million (USD211 million).

item.title: Czech SMR environmental impact assessment submitted
item.description: ČEZ has submitted the Environmental Impact Assessment documentation to the Ministry of the Environment for its Rolls-Royce SMR small modular reactor project in Temelín.

item.title: Joint venture formed for six-unit SMR plant in Poland
item.description: Poland's SGE and ZE Pak have agreed to establish a joint venture to develop a nuclear power plant in Pątnów which will feature up to six BWRX-300 small modular reactors.

item.title: Multiple milestones for India's nuclear projects
item.description: Technical studies have begun onsite for Kakrapar units 5 and 6, two 700 MWe reactors planned for construction in Gujarat; India's Nuclear Fuels Complex is making steam generator tubes to support the fleet mode construction project; and India's small modular reactor project has reached a design milestone.

item.title: Timeline for Polish nuclear units slips in updated programme
item.description: Poland's Council of Ministers has adopted an update to the country's nuclear power programme - a strategic document outlining the  development of nuclear energy in Poland - with the first nuclear power plant now expected to start up in 2036 and the second one in 2040.
